context: Hina has wandered away from her mother in the train station and a kindly station attendant has brought her to Officer Takeda.
purpose: civic kindness around a lost child — professional gentleness reassuring a small one

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: こんにちは。怖くないからね、大丈夫。
lines.en: Hello. It's not scary, you're alright.
lines.style: Officer warm kneeling-down register, the child-tuned reassurance audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: High child wavering wet voice, the small wobbling fear audible, soft small distress threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: うん、お母さんね。すぐ呼ぶから、落ち着いて。
lines.en: Yes, your mother. I'll call her right away, so calm down.
lines.style: Officer steady warm professional kindness, the gentle adult-authority calming, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ぼうし、ピンクの、お母さん…。
lines.style: High child wobbling helpful detail, the trying-to-help-find-her audible, soft small bravery threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ピンクの帽子、いいね。教えてくれてありがとう。
lines.en: Pink hat — good. Thanks for telling me.
lines.style: Officer warm validation, the gentle praise for the useful information, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: High child small steadying voice, the slight calming audible in the request, soft small recovery threading throughout.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい、お水ね。一緒に待とう。
lines.style: Officer warm steady continuation, the calm comforting presence audible, soft real care threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: …うん。お巡りさん、ありがとう。
lines.style: High child small recovering politeness, the calmed gentleness audible, soft small earnest gratitude threading throughout delivery.
